Lasagna

pasta
beef
baking
casserole
italian

Ingredients

  • 1lb ground beef
  • 1lb ground pork
  • 1lb lasagna noodles (dry)
  • 2 lb whole milk ricotta
  • 1 medium yellow onion (diced)
  • 2 medium carrots (diced)
  • 2 celery sticks (diced)
  • 4 garlic cloves (minced)
  • 4 oz red wine
  • 1 Tbsp tomato paste
  • 1 32 oz can marinara
  • 2 cups shredded parm
  • 2 Tbsp dried basil
  • 2 Tbsp dried oregano
  • 1 lb shredded mozzeralla

Procedure

Prep the noodles

  1. cook to package instructions

Prep the meat

  1. Saute beef and pork in batches until complete and remove from pan
  2. Drain excess fat
  3. Add 1 tbsp fat back and saute carrots (4 min)
  4. Add onion, saute 4 min
  5. Add celery, saute 2 min
  6. Add garlic and tomato paste, saute until fragrant (30s)
  7. add wine, cook until reduced slightly
  8. Add back meat
  9. Add marinara

Prep the cheese

  1. Combine ricotta, parmesan, basil, and oregano.
  2. salt and pepper as needed

Build and bake

  1. start with a layer of meat sauce
  2. layer noodles
  3. layer ricotta mixture
  4. layer shredded mozz
  5. layer noodles
  6. repeate until done. Be sure to end with meat then shredded mozz
  7. bake 375 for 25 minutes
